name: DEAD OF THE BRAIN2
source:
Third part of the Nightmare Collection with [url=https://vndb.org/v4513]Dead of the Brain[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/v8961]Marine Philt[/url].

The events of the game take place shortly after the ending of the first game. The devastating zombie invasion, caused by the scientist Dr. Cooger and his resurrection medicine, was finally stopped, and the young hero Cole could marry his sweetheart Sheila. But alas, if only everything could be so simple... A biker gang starts terrorizing the town. Sheila and Cole find a dead body in Cole's apartment. And soon they discover that not all the traces of the resurrection medicine were destroyed...

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/nightmare-collection-dead-of-the-brain-2]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
本作与[url=https://vndb.org/v4513]《Dead of the Brain》[/url]、[url=https://vndb.org/v8961]《Marine Philt》[/url]共同构成《Nightmare Collection》的第三部分。

故事发生在初代结局后不久。科学家库格博士研制的复活药引发了毁灭性的丧尸入侵，但灾难终于得到遏制，年轻的主人公科尔也得以迎娶心爱的希拉。可惜，事情要是真有那么简单就好了……一群飞车党开始恐吓城镇居民。希拉和科尔在科尔的公寓里发现一具尸体。很快，他们发现复活药留下的痕迹并未全部消失……

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/nightmare-collection-dead-of-the-brain-2]MobyGames[/url]]
